complete_examples.text: Track–substructure local coordinates are defined to assist the confirming of the overlapped portions between the train–track system and the substructural system to effec-tively combine the cyclic calculation and iterative solution procedures.

An ingenious tactics is developed to consider the vibration participation of multiple substructures, such as tunnel and bridge, in the train–track interaction process at arbitrary time or position by DOF mapping relation and iterative solution.
